name: Barrier
description: A point an update waits at (D104): a Workflow on status with fixed states (waiting, released, cancelled); Rollups' all over the rows of another table that relate to the barrier, ready when every one of them has finished with the outcome success, which gates released; a Timers deadline whose then releases the barrier once the timeout has passed since it began waiting; and the move from waiting to released behind a permission, a person's go-ahead. The gate holds the deadline's move and the go-ahead's alike, so a barrier is released only once every row is ready: the deadline's release, at the timeout, is vetoed while a row is not, its fire then recorded vetoed and not tried again, and a person's go-ahead releases the barrier once every row is ready. The worker that runs the table's deadlines holds the release permission.

rows.description: The table whose rows relate to the barrier, each of which says it is ready by finishing its Workflow with the outcome success.

link.description: The to-one relation of that table to the barrier.

timeoutMs.description: How long after the barrier begins waiting its deadline releases it, in milliseconds.

releasePermission.description: The permission a caller needs to release the barrier: a person's go-ahead.
